name: pandoc
description: 通用的文档格式转换工具，支持 Markdown、HTML、LaTeX、DOCX、PDF、EPUB 等数十种格式互转。

options.description: Specify input format (e.g. markdown, html, latex, docx).
Specify output format (e.g. html, docx, pdf, epub).
Write output to FILE instead of stdout.
Produce output with an appropriate header and footer (e.g. a standalone HTML page).
List supported input formats and exit.
List supported output formats and exit.
Include an automatically generated table of contents in the output document.
Number section headings in LaTeX, ConTeXt, HTML, or EPUB output.
Use FILE as a custom template for the generated document.
Set the template variable KEY to the value VAL.
Set the metadata field KEY to the value VAL.
Link to a CSS style sheet. Repeated to include multiple files.
Specifies the coloring style to be used in highlighted source code.
Include contents of FILE (verbatim) at the end of the header.
Include contents of FILE at the beginning of the document body.
Include contents of FILE at the end of the document body.
Process the document through the Lua filter SCRIPT.
Specify an executable to be used as a filter transforming the document.
Determine how text is wrapped. Possible values: auto, none, preserve. [default: auto]
Specify length of lines in characters. [default: 72]
Preserve tabs instead of converting them to spaces.
Specify number of spaces per tab. [default: 4]
Use ENGINE to produce PDF output. Possible values: pdflatex, lualatex, xelatex, etc.
Specify the user data directory to search for pandoc data files.
Suppress warning messages.
Print version and exit.
Show usage message and exit.
